The structure of Na8Al4Cu4F24 (reduced formula Na2AlCuF6) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with 40 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Al and Cu each as octahedral centers coordinated by six F neighbors, while Na adopts a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 F neighbors; the Al and Cu octahedra share corners, and face-sharing links Al–Na and Cu–Na polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites.
